name: Narumi Kousuke
source:
Kousuke seeks independence from parental authority so he works hard to save money to fund his own studies. After saving enough, he moves to a countryside waving goodbye to his parents who respect his decision and send him cheerfully.

As someone who longs for peaceful countryside life away from the bustle of the city where he grow up, Kousuke is very enthusiastic about the move... only to end up being forced to live in an all-girl dormitory as a cross-dresser.
